task.title: Select exact extension registry capabilities
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/609 by validating caller-selected exact IDs against one immutable snapshot before any activation boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Resolve valid and empty selections without filesystem access or mutation.
Return borrowed records in exact-ID order independent of request order.
Reject duplicate and absent IDs with typed source-free errors and no partial result.
Preserve case and surrounding whitespace as identity-significant.

attempts.summary: Established RED coverage for exact-ID selection.
attempts.diagnostic: The immutable registry supported individual lookup but had no all-or-nothing operation for validating a caller-owned set of capability IDs.
attempts.patch: Added focused tests for valid, empty, reordered, duplicate, absent, and case-or-whitespace-distinct selections.

attempts.diagnostic: Sorting caller IDs in a set provides deterministic output while a separate duplicate set preserves explicit duplicate rejection.
attempts.patch: Added ExtensionRegistry::select, typed duplicate and not-found errors, borrowed results, docs, and milestone evidence.

attempts.summary: Verified selection stayed outside lifecycle and permission boundaries.
attempts.diagnostic: Identity validation must not be described as loading, enablement, authorization, or reusable permission.
attempts.patch: Clarified public documentation and non-goals while retaining source-free deterministic selection errors.

outcome.summary: Vela now validates exact caller-selected capability IDs against one immutable registry snapshot as an ordered all-or-nothing borrowed result without activation.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test -p vela-extensions --test manifest registry_select
GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30183315792 and substantive exact-head CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/610

lessons: Caller-owned selection should validate identity before any loader or permission policy is introduced.
Duplicate requests are a distinct input error and should not disappear through set deduplication.
Deterministic ordering makes equivalent caller intent produce equivalent observable results.
Selecting installed metadata does not activate, authorize, or execute a capability.
